eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 哈希溯源

headline.zh:
一条命令锁定国产模型权重
镜像到 Gitee/ModelScope 并校验
headline.en:
Pin CN model weights in one command
Mirror to Gitee/ModelScope with hash proof

sub.zh: 把 DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM 权重从 Hugging Face 声明式锁定、镜像到国产平台、并逐文件校验 SHA256 — 不再依赖单一来源。
sub.en: Declaratively pin DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM weights from Hugging Face, mirror to CN platforms, and verify SHA256 per file — no single-source dependency.

title.zh: 声明式锁定，不是手动下载

body.zh: 在 weights.lock.yaml 里写明模型名和文件，一条命令解析、下载、校验 — 像包管理器锁定依赖一样锁定权重。
body.en: List models and files in weights.lock.yaml; one command parses, downloads, and verifies — pinning weights like a package manager pins dependencies.

title.zh: 镜像到国产平台，不再依赖单一来源
title.en: Mirror to CN platforms, no single-source dependency

body.zh: NVIDIA 收购 Hugging Face 后，权重来源的稳定性存疑。hflock 把权重镜像到 Gitee AI 和 ModelScope，哈希可追溯。
body.en: After NVIDIA acquired Hugging Face, weight source stability is uncertain. hflock mirrors to Gitee AI and ModelScope with traceable hashes.

body.zh: Go 编译的单二进制，放进 CI pipeline 或离线环境即可使用 — 不需要 Python 运行时，不需要账号。
body.en: A single Go binary that drops into CI pipelines or air-gapped environments — no Python runtime, no account required.

headline.zh: 开始锁定你的模型权重

sub.zh: MIT 开源 · 一条命令安装
sub.en: MIT open source · one command install
